name: build-pipeline
body: The build + release pipeline that compiles and stages the seven language frontends plus the bundled structural scanner: `build.rs` (build script driven by `APG_BUILD_FRONTENDS`, used by dev and CI `cargo build`), the CI release workflow — the `linux` job (builds and packages the per-language tarballs) and the `bottle` job (builds the bottles through the split formulae) — and the split Homebrew formulae (`apg-go`/`apg-java`/`apg-cpp`/`apg-rust`/`apg-ts`/`apg-csharp`/`apg-py`), each of which builds one frontend directly. The bundled structural scanner is built by `build.rs` and ships in the base `scanner` package, so `apg-md` retires as a separate formula. It owns the toolchain pins. `install.sh` is a download-only installer of prebuilt release tarballs and is not part of this pipeline. The CI workflow and the formulae are config artifacts the 0.16.1 code graph does not model, so the plan carries their pin edits; `build.rs` is the graph-visible half of the pipeline. (0.17.0's structural scanner gives them `File` nodes — `release.yml` as `yaml`, the `Formula/*.rb` files as residual `misc` with no symbols — so from the next binary onward they are targetable; for this change-set the plan still carries their edits, see `solution.note.structural-scanner-oroboros`.)
